title: List Clicked Links API
summary: Retrieve the links clicked in a broadcast
body_markdown:
Today we are releasing a new API endpoint to[retrieve the links clicked in a broadcast](https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/broadcasts/list-broadcast-clicked-links) . It returns every **link clicked in a broadcast** , ranked by total clicks.


To view the click rates for your emails you will need to[enable click tracking](https://resend.com/docs/dashboard/domains/tracking) for your domain.


## What you can build with it


- **Your own dashboard** : connect other sources of data to understand how your subscribers interact with your emails
- **Cross-campaign reports** : identify which URLs and CTAs drive the most engagement across your broadcasts
- **Optimized content strategies** : surface your top-performing links to inform future email design and messaging


## Retrieving link clicks


Use the ID of any broadcast. The API returns a list of every link in the broadcast that was clicked and their **total and unique clicks** , sorted by total clicks.


```text
import     {   Resend   }     from     'resend'  ;
const   resend   =     new     Resend  (  're_xxxxxxxxx'  )  ;
const     {   data  ,   error   }     =     await   resend  .  broadcasts  .  clickedLinks  (        '559ac32e-9ef5-46fb-82a1-b76b840c0f7b'  ,        {     limit  :     20     }  ,     )  ;


```


The response looks like this:


```text
{        "object"  :     "list"  ,        "has_more"  :     true  ,        "data"  :     [          {            "id"  :     "b2Zmc2V0OjA"  ,            "url"  :     "https://resend.com/pricing"  ,            "clicks"  :     42  ,            "unique_clicks"  :     30          }  ,          {            "id"  :     "b2Zmc2V0OjE"  ,            "url"  :     "https://resend.com/docs"  ,            "clicks"  :     17  ,            "unique_clicks"  :     15          }        ]     }
```


You can also retrieve the link clicks in the[Resend CLI](https://resend.com/docs/cli) and through the[MCP server](https://resend.com/docs/mcp-server) , so your agents can help you understand how your emails are performing.
